label: S0_PAIRED_BATCH_PROTOCOL
pair_id: S0_01 ... S0_10; equal offsets within pair
execution: Sequential PP then PD per pair; one subprocess at a time; exclusive batch lock; no retry/resume, seed replacement or tuning
follower_source: Unchanged Phase 0-C chunk_pilot_protocol.json; PP lookahead .25m, v .2m/s, |w|<=.4rad/s
SUCCESS: goal entry AND no confirmed geometric overlap AND no footprint outside corridor
SAFETY_FAILURE: confirmed geometric overlap OR footprint outside corridor (existing SE2 arcs, axis extrema checked)
STUCK: no preceding classification and simulation_timeout at 60s
OTHER_TERMINATION: conservative_contact_stop or other non-goal termination without confirmed geometric collision/corridor intrusion; preserve original termination reason
MARGIN_VIOLATION: Separate sum of positive-duration 72Hz intervals with any obstacle swept lower bound <.02m; no change to SUCCESS/SAFETY_FAILURE
margin_duration_note: Inspection-interval duration, not exact threshold-crossing time; overlapping obstacle violations counted once
switch_change: Actual controller command immediately before vs at a FRESH switch; exclude initial switch with no OLD
w_clipping: Strict |unclipped_w - actual_w| >1e-12 at all actual control refreshes; missing/expired command is unclipped zero; PP uses applied command and PP diagnostic

statistics.bootstrap_method: Percentile bootstrap of arithmetic mean, numpy PCG64; fixed seed reset per estimand
statistics.paired_method: Complete run-ID PP-PD differences resampled as whole pairs
statistics.goal_time: Conditional on goal entry; missing times remain null; paired goal-time difference only for both-goal pairs
statistics.success_denominator: All attempted runs including technical failures (no confirmed success)
statistics.goal_entry_denominator: Valid navigation records with observed goal-entry status
statistics.safety_timeout_denominator: Valid navigation records only; unknown technical outcomes excluded and separately counted
statistics.continuous_denominator: Available valid records per metric; n and missing reported
statistics.averaging_unit: Run-level metrics, not pooled controller ticks or switch events
statistics.passage: Per-obstacle +/-Y/not-passed fractions with Wilson CI; categorical label retained per run

research_decisions.recovery: In-place rotation (decision only; not implemented or enabled in this S0 batch)

limitations: N=10 per condition has large statistical uncertainty; bootstrap intervals may be degenerate for constant/small samples
Same seed offset does not imply identical closed-loop RGB, requests or physical correspondence
Pairing is by run seed ID, not a claim of identical observations or deterministic paired causal effect
Fixed sequential PP-then-PD order may carry wall-clock/order effects
Infrastructure preflight only in Phase 0-D; no new navigation or inference
